raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "In-plane domain aspect ratio",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "The problem schematic is square, whereas the target-design image is approximately 1.75 times wider than tall. Physical dimensions and element aspect ratios are not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "W/H = 1; interpret Fig. 8 as a stretched rendering of the square domain.",
        "W/H approximately 1.75; interpret the Fig. 8 outline as the physical domain proportions."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Fig. 6(a): square domain. Fig. 8 target design: rectangular outline. Sec. 5 specifies 100 × 100 elements without physical dimensions."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Magnitude of the central downward force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The force arrow has no numerical magnitude.",
      "readings": [
        "F = 1 in consistent force units.",
        "F = 1000 in the same force units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 6(a) labels the arrow only as 'Force'; Sec. 7.1.1 supplies no magnitude."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The solid modulus is defined symbolically but its absolute value is not supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "E1 = 1 using normalized stiffness units.",
        "E1 = 210 GPa using dimensional material properties."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4, Eq. (3) defines E1; neither Sec. 5 nor Sec. 7.1.1 gives its value."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Void-to-solid stiffness ratio E0/E1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The residual void stiffness is introduced but its ratio to solid stiffness is unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "E0/E1 = 1e-9.",
        "E0/E1 = 1e-6."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4, Eq. (3) introduces E0 and E1; Sec. 5 lists penal, rmin and ft without specifying the stiffness contrast."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is stated for the elastic material.",
      "readings": [
        "nu = 0.30.",
        "nu = 0.25."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Secs. 4 and 4.1 describe the elastic FE formulation without specifying Poisson's ratio; Sec. 7.1.1 adds no material constants."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The supplied text does not explicitly select plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4 specifies bilinear quadrilateral elements, and Sec. 4.1 names top88, but the supplied formulation does not state the plane assumption."
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No thickness or explicit unit-thickness convention is given for the two-dimensional model.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t = 1 in the chosen length units.",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in the same length units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Fig. 6(a) supplies only an in-plane schematic; Secs. 4 and 4.1 do not specify thickness."
    }
  ]
}
